items.text: video length: until you stop, 10 s, 30 s, 1 minute, or 4, 8 or 16 bars at the tempo; it stops by itself
titles for videos and GIFs: an intro with the name and CURRENT, an outro with the duck-rabbit and the link, and fades in and out
a muted mixer channel still shows its wave, in grey, so you can see what you would bring back
batch export (Artist): pick looks and/or words and each is captured as a still, GIF or video, then saved together as one .zip; open it from the capture panel
the mixer's rows follow the sound shelf, left to right: mic, music, beat, bytebeat
tap tempo on the sound shelf (or the b key): the beats play at your tempo and line up with your taps; new looks and the word sequence follow your beat; hold to let go
an app left open on a computer now notices a new version by itself: it checks when you come back to it and every five minutes
after an update, "Updated to …" shows once, with what's new one tap away
mute is first on the sound shelf, at the far left
a master row in the mixer: overall volume with the live line of everything you hear, and M to mute (the field keeps moving)
each mixer channel shows its sound live, a wave behind its slider; the level's share of the track is tinted
